# /etc/systemd/system/venture-level2c-ceo.service
[Unit]
Description=Level 2C Autonomous Preparation CEO (bounded, no live authority)
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target venture-control-broker-mtls.service
Requires=venture-control-broker-mtls.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=venture-ceo
Group=venture-ceo
WorkingDirectory=/usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c
EnvironmentFile=/etc/venture-ceo-level2c.env
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B -m agents.ceo.preparation_exchange --config /usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c/artifacts/level2c-ceo/config.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
CapabilityBoundingSet=
ReadWritePaths=/usr/local/lib/venture-ceo-level2c/artifacts

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
